race.description: Ray White Pakenham & Officer Mdn Plate
race.comment: SEINFELD (7) disappointed first up at Cranbourne when hard in the market, clearly off his game there as a $3.10 hope when finishing last over 1400m. Second up in his maiden campaign he ran the talented Ichnusa within a length over this trip so we'll forgive him a shocker fresh and expect sharp improvement up in trip on the bigger deck. MONTESQUIEU (6) resumes, now with the Begg yard. He showed talent in four runs last time in when getting out over a trip and this looks an ideal spot to kick off. ARDAD NED (2) resumes after a year off having placed in both Irish maiden runs to date. The debut was an especially hot race, only a neck off Melbourne Cup runner James J Braddock. Watch betting. CHRONIC (4) just found one better at Moe last time and is in the mix again. WOLLEMI (10) was okay on debut and can improve into a placing.
